给需要到澳大利亚参加职业培训、或去做与专业相关的结构化工作培训的人用的临时签证，: A temporary visa for people who need to come to Australia for occupational training, or for structured workplace training related to their occupation, lasting up to 2 years. The order is fixed: sponsor first, nomination second. An Australian employer (or a Commonwealth government agency) must first be approved as a sponsor and must separately lodge a nomination for your training program that Home Affairs approves, and only then can you apply for the visa. During training you may do work directly related to it, but this is not a way to take an ordinary job. From 2026-11-12 you must be outside Australia both when you apply and when the visa is granted.
官方资格清单按「担保 + 提名 + 个人条件」判定，未按国籍设限；中国大陆护照持: The official eligibility list tests three things — sponsor, nomination and personal circumstances — and sets no limit by nationality, so mainland Chinese passport holders can apply. The real constraint is getting a nomination from an Australian sponsor, which is decided largely by the employer rather than by the passport.
官方原文：`Usually, you must be 18 years old: Official wording: `Usually, you must be 18 years old or older at the time we decide your visa application.` There is a minimum of 18 and no maximum; 99 here means "no upper limit", not "to be verified". Applications from people under 18 are assessed separately against the best interests of the child: not an absolute bar, but stricter conditions.
官方对学历不做统一硬性规定，门槛落在「培训项目本身」上：须属于三类之一——① 为: The official page sets no uniform qualification requirement; the test falls on the training program itself, which must be one of three types: (1) occupational training required for registration or licensing in your current occupation or field; (2) structured workplace training, including a school-organised internship or training arranged to improve skills; (3) professional development training while in Australia. Whether it qualifies depends on the training plan in the nomination, not on the level of your degree.
官方要求具备「功能性英语（functional English）」，并在资格清单: The requirement is "functional English", listed as a separate item in the eligibility list; the accepted tests and scores are on the department's English requirements page. The database does not record individual scores because they change with policy, so check the current official page before applying.
官方资格清单里没有单独的资金门槛条款。但需满足健康、品行、真实临时入境者（gen: The official eligibility list has no separate funds test, but you must still meet the health, character and genuine temporary entrant requirements and in practice need enough to cover your costs in Australia; pay during training comes from the sponsor under the training arrangement and should not be assumed to cover the full cost of living.
须有已获批的担保方（approved sponsor）与已获批的提名（appro: You need an approved sponsor and an approved nomination. Official wording: `Your sponsor must have nominated you for a program of occupational training unless they are an Australian Commonwealth Government agency.` and `We must approve this nomination before you can apply for this visa.` The sequence is therefore sponsor approved, nomination approved, then your application; skipping a step makes the application invalid.
申请人及随行家庭成员须满足健康要求（meet our health requir: The applicant and accompanying family members must meet our health requirement.
申请人及随行 16 岁及以上家庭成员须满足品行要求（meet our chara: The applicant and accompanying family members aged 16 or over must meet our character requirement.
官方明确在澳期间的医疗费用由本人承担，须为整个停留期维持足够的医疗保险（`You: The official page makes clear that medical costs in Australia are your own responsibility and that you must maintain adequate health cover for the whole stay (`You must maintain adequate health cover for the whole of your stay`).
官方资格清单未单列返程机票；但须是「真实临时入境者」，即只打算临时停留、只做签证: The official eligibility list does not list a return ticket, but you must be a genuine temporary entrant: intending only a temporary stay, doing only what the visa permits, and having substantially complied with the conditions of any visa you previously held.

Your application will be invalid if you apply while in Australia.`). The department specifically warns that even if ImmiAccount lets you lodge from inside Australia, the application is still invalid.
官方签证页的资格清单里没有名额条款，全年滚动受理，不设排队或抽签。实际能否成行取: The eligibility list on the official visa page contains no quota provision; applications are accepted all year on a rolling basis, with no queue or ballot. Whether you can go depends on whether a sponsor is willing to nominate you — an employer-side limit that no published immigration figure governs.
全年滚动递交，官方页最后更新 2026-10-30。2026-11-12 起新增: Rolling applications all year; the official page was last updated on 2026-10-30. From 2026-11-12 a new restriction applies: you must be outside Australia when you apply and when the visa is granted.
滚动制没有年度开放窗口，规则按内政部页面当期版本执行；该页在 2026-10-3: Rolling processing means no annual opening window; the rules follow the current version of the Home Affairs page, which was updated on 2026-10-30, so re-check it once a quarter.
官方页面把金额写成由前端脚本注入的 `BasePrice` 占位符（`From: The official page renders the amount as a `BasePrice` placeholder injected by front-end script (`From <span data-svpattribute="BasePrice" ...>`), so the figure cannot be scraped from the page directly; look it up in the department's Visa Pricing Estimator for subclass 407 in the currency of the day. 官方不给固定天数，只把申请人指向 Visa processing time gu: No fixed number of days is given; applicants are pointed to the Visa processing time guide, which shows recent decision times and which the department describes as a guide only, not specific to your application. 签证的前置条件，不是申请人自己准备的材料：担保方须先获批（approved sp: A precondition rather than something the applicant prepares: the sponsor must first be approved, then lodge and have approved a nomination for your training program. The application is linked to it by nomination number.
提名的核心材料，须说清培训属于三类中的哪一类、培训内容与你的职业/专业如何相关、: The core document of the nomination: it must state which of the three training types applies, how the training relates to your occupation or field, who supervises it and how long it runs. A vague training plan is the main reason nominations are refused.

16 岁及以上申请人及随行家庭成员须提供，以满足品行要求。中国申请人通常需办《无: Required for applicants aged 16 or over and for accompanying family members, to meet the character requirement. Chinese applicants usually need a certificate of no criminal record with an English translation or notarisation.
须覆盖整个停留期。官方强调医疗费用由本人承担，保险是降低财务风险的手段。: Must cover the whole stay. The department stresses that medical costs are your own responsibility, and insurance is a way to reduce the financial risk.
18 岁及以上申请人须已阅读（或被解释过）澳大利亚价值观声明，并在申请中确认。: Applicants aged 18 or over must have read (or had explained to them) the Australian Values Statement and confirm it in the application.

2026-11-12 起，递交与获批时人都必须在澳大利亚境外。官方特别说明：即使: From 2026-11-12 you must be outside Australia both when you apply and when the visa is granted. 官方原文：签证最长可获批 2 年（`We might grant you a v: Official wording: the visa may be granted for up to 2 years (`We might grant you a visa allowing you to stay in Australia for up to 2 years`). 407 的定位是培训而不是就业，所以没有「同雇主上限」这类为打工度假设的条款。工: 407 is a training visa, not an employment one, so it carries no same-employer cap of the kind working holiday schemes need. Work rights are tied to the training program: work outside its scope breaches the visa conditions.
顺序不能颠倒：担保方获批 → 提名获批 → 递签。很多人先递了签证再找雇主，结果: The order cannot be reversed: sponsor approved, nomination approved, then apply. Many people apply first and look for an employer afterwards, which leads to refusal and a refusal on record.
2026-11-12 起，境内递交的 407 申请无效。官方特意提醒「即使 Im: From 2026-11-12 an onshore 407 application is invalid. The department goes out of its way to warn that even if ImmiAccount accepts it, it is invalid. Anyone already in Australia should not count on this route to change status.

与 462 打工度假的取舍：462 是先抽签再申请、允许自由打工度假且有中国大陆: Versus the 462 working holiday visa: 462 requires a ballot before application, allows free working-holiday employment and has an annual cap for mainland China; 407 has no ballot and no cap, but requires an employer sponsor and a training program. 给「工作地点不依赖所在地」的远程工作者用的居留许可：人在马耳他住，为外国雇主或外: A residence permit for remote workers whose work does not depend on where they live: you live in Malta and work remotely for a foreign employer or foreign clients, initially for 1 year, renewable on application. The core threshold is gross annual income of at least €42,000, and you must fit one of three remote-work categories (employed by a foreign employer, holding shares in a foreign company, or freelancing or consulting for foreign clients). It is a residence permit, not a work permit — it cannot be used to work for a Maltese employer.
官方资格是「第三国国民（非欧盟、非欧洲经济区、非瑞士）」，并单列了一份排除名单。: Eligibility is for third-country nationals (not EU, EEA or Swiss), and the official page lists a set of excluded countries. Mainland China is not on the exclusion list, so mainland Chinese passport holders can apply. The excluded countries are Afghanistan, North Korea, Iran, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Yemen and Venezuela, and persons closely connected with them; applications from the Russian Federation and Belarus face additional restrictions.

官方资格清单未设语言考试要求。材料需以英文提交，实际需要具备处理英文合同与官方表: The official eligibility list sets no language test. Documents must be submitted in English, so in practice you need to be able to handle English contracts and official forms, but this is not a separately assessed eligibility condition.
年毛收入下限 €42,000（`a minimum gross yearly i: The minimum gross annual income is €42,000 (`a minimum gross yearly income of €42,000`). 规则按官方页面当期版本执行，无年度开放窗口。收入门槛在 2024-04-01 从: The rules follow the current version of the official page, with no annual opening window. The income threshold rose from €32,400 to €42,000 on 2024-04-01, which shows the figure can change; re-check it before applying.

这是居留许可，不是工作许可：允许的是「为外国雇主/客户远程工作」，不允许为马耳他: This is a residence permit, not a work permit: it allows remote work for foreign employers or clients but not work for a Maltese employer. Dependants cannot join the initial application and can only be added at renewal (newborns excepted).
它不是工作签证。拿它去马耳他本地公司上班属于违反许可条件；它允许的是「人住在马耳: It is not a work visa. Using it to take a job with a Maltese company breaches the permit conditions; what it allows is living in Malta while working abroad. Misreading this is enough to lose your status.

与其它欧洲数字游民签证的比较：马耳他的门槛（€42,000 年收入）在欧洲属中等: Compared with other European digital nomad visas, Malta's threshold (€42,000 a year) is mid-range for Europe; its distinguishing features are English as an official language, a defined processing period (30 working days) and an explicit exclusion of the grey area of serving a local subsidiary. Because this is a fundamentally different quota basis from an annual grant cap, quota_basis is recorded as concurrent.
